name: Lanterns
source:
Some questions remain unanswered. That’s part of the story. What matters is that the ending is always there, waiting.

[From [url=https://broodygaming.itch.io/lanterns]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有些問題始終沒有答案。這也是故事的一部分。要緊的是，結局永遠在那裡，等著你。
